request.description: Initiates the CLI Auth flow by requesting a device code and verification URLs. This endpoint implements the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Flow ([RFC 8628](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8628)) and is designed for command-line applications or other devices with limited input capabilities.
